title: Sygnal app graph (inspect)
description: The machine-readable structure of a Sygnal app, produced at runtime (inspect() / getDevTools().inspect() / renderComponent's t.inspect() from the 'sygnal/diagnostics' dev entry) and statically (sygnal-check --graph --json). Fields one side cannot know are null or omitted. TypeScript: InspectGraph in sygnal/diagnostics.

events.description: EVENTS bus: type -> names (and, static, ids) of the components that emit / select it

emitterIds.description: the id of every emitting component (static) or instance (runtime); not parallel to emitters, which lists each name once (D528)

selectorIds.description: the id of every selecting component (static) or instance (runtime); not parallel to selectors (D528)

diagnostics.description: Diagnostics not tied to a listed component

recentActions.description: runtime only, with inspect({ actions }): the most recent actions of any instance, oldest first

id.description: runtime: instance number; static: 'file:line' of the definition

key.description: static (PLAN-10 D521): 'file#name', stable when lines move; a second component of the same name in one file gets 'file#name#2', and so on. Absent at runtime (no source positions)

parentId.description: runtime: parent instance id; static: null

file.description: static only: source file relative to the working directory

viewOnly.description: a function rendered as a component (or started as an entry) that has no statics (runtime: the instance's component function has none)

entry.description: static: started by run(), defineElement() or a Vike +Page/+Layout; 'unknown' on the other roots when an entry call's component can't be resolved (picked at run time); runtime: true on an app's root instance (parentId null); omitted otherwise

app.description: runtime: the app (run()) the instance belongs to, 0 for the earliest live root; omitted statically

shown.description: runtime: false on a hidden Switchable page and the instances below it; omitted when shown

contextConsumes.description: context fields read in the view (static); null at runtime

contextEntries.description: static: where the `context` static's entries are (contextProvides with locations); omitted when unknown or none

eventSites.description: static: the EVENTS emit and select sites of its intent and model; omitted when none

file.description: static: when not the component's file

childSelects.description: static: the CHILD.select(Child) calls of its intent (the receivers of the child's PARENT sink); omitted when none

uses.description: static: the entries of the component's `uses` static (behaviors); omitted when it has none

controls.description: controls (controls() element tokens) the component renders; omitted when there are none

commands.description: static: the element commands (ELEMENT sink) its model sends; omitted when there are none

timers.description: static: the literal timer specs of its `timers` static; omitted when there are none

agent.description: static: the component's `agent` declaration (sygnal/ai); omitted when it has none

name.description: the literal agent.name; null when absent or not a literal

tools.description: the tool-name prefix (agent.name, else the component name, snake_case); null when not static

read.description: the declaration has a read projection

consequential.description: consequential: true (the user confirms each call)

input.description: the action takes input (has an input schema)

file.description: static: when not the component's file

queries.description: the read-only `agent.queries` tools (run(state, input) => result); omitted when none

input.description: the query takes input (has an input schema)

file.description: static: when not the component's file

partial.description: the declaration, its actions or its queries have spreads: what is listed may be incomplete

action.description: the model entry that sends it

target.description: the control's key or the selector; null when not static

triggers.description: intent actions listening on the target for a native event the command causes (close, toggle...)

file.description: static: when not the component's file

frame.description: the action a frame timer dispatches

file.description: static: when not the component's file

trigger.description: agent: only an agent declaration (sygnal/ai) dispatches it (static); behavior: a behavior's action nothing else triggers that the behavior may dispatch itself in a way the checker can't list (static)

behavior.description: the `uses` key of the behavior that owns this action ('pager' for 'pager.NEXT')

file.description: static: when not the component's file

key.description: the state key and action prefix

behavior.description: the behavior's name (its factory), when resolved

status.description: resolved to a defineBehavior() definition or a first-party behavior; opaque (e.g. from a package); invalid (not a behavior, SYG127)

from.description: Collection: the state field it renders, when known

count.description: runtime: live instances behind this entry

ids.description: runtime: the ids of those instances (count of them)

id.description: static: the id of the component it renders (resolved through the import); null when it isn't in the graph (a package, a widget, a file not scanned, a dynamic value)

state.description: static: the literal `state` lens of a tag (<Greeting state="host" />)

external.description: static: the package the tag is imported from ('sygnal/ui')

widget.description: static: a widget tag (defineWidget, fromZag, fromReact, the sygnal/ui Zag parts)

file.description: static: when not the component's file

matched.description: matches an element the component itself renders (static: in the view source; renderComponent: in the latest render; real DOM: seen by the DOM checks); null when unknown

isolationHit.description: child component whose isolated elements the selector matches instead

control.description: the control this selector is (its key), when the intent passed a control

behavior.description: the `uses` key of the behavior that listens to it (a control or selector passed as its option)

file.description: static: when not the component's file

element.description: the intrinsic tag for a tag spec; null for a spec object

listened.description: the component's intent listens to it; null when unknown

file.description: static: when not the component's file

location.description: static: a source position (1-based); file only when it isn't the component's file

file.description: static: when not the component's file
static: when not the component's file

child.description: the selected component's name as written

id.description: its id; null when it isn't in the graph

actions.description: the intent actions whose stream contains the call (the PARENT receivers)

file.description: static: when not the component's file

componentId.description: static: the id of the component it is attached to

fix.description: a mechanical fix (static only): its edits are applied together

textEdit.description: replace start..end (UTF-16 offsets; the same range 1-based as line/column..endLine/endColumn, endColumn exclusive) of file with text
